name: zoia-desktop
description: Zoia broadcaster — screen and per-application audio over WebRTC.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.pack: npm run build:native && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 && electron-builder install-app-deps
scripts.build:native: cd native && npm ci && node-gyp rebuild --target=44.4.3 --dist-url=https://electronjs.org/headers --arch=x64
